Name: Rephah
Summary: Son of Ephraim, named in Ephraim's line after Beriah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:25: Son of Ephraim, named in Ephraim's line after Beriah.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Rephah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
